answer: Sybil resistance follows from reputation decaying exponentially with a fixed half-life: influence earned by an identity fades unless it sustains honest, reciprocated service over time. In the EigenTrust-style matrix, a newly spawned identity has almost no trusted incoming paths, so its eigenvector centrality stays near zero; splitting activity among aliases does not create trust or meet consensus thresholds. Like pigment in an orchard washed toward the ocean, unsupported influence dissipates.
